test_add_bookmark.title: Create a bookmark on a streaming video tile

steps.action: Open Views and load the configured camera into a tile.
steps.expected: The camera streams in the first tile.

steps.action: Enter full screen and bookmark the current position.
steps.expected: A new bookmark appears in the bookmarks panel.

steps.action: Delete the bookmark this test created.

test_open_bookmarks_panel.title: Verify bookmarks panel opens when clicking the dots icon

steps.action: In full screen, click the bookmarks dots icon.
steps.expected: The panel opens and lists the bookmark.

test_close_bookmarks_panel.title: Verify bookmarks panel closes when clicking the dots icon again

steps.action: With the panel open, click the dots icon again.
steps.expected: The bookmark rows are no longer shown.

test_play_bookmark.title: Verify clicking a bookmark navigates to that snapshot position

steps.action: Click the bookmark in the panel.
steps.expected: The player streams that archive position, not live.

test_bookmark_options_menu.title: Verify the 3-dot options menu shows 4 options

steps.action: Click the 3-dot icon on the bookmark row.
steps.expected: The menu shows Rename, Export, Share and Delete.

test_export_bookmark.title: Verify a bookmark can be exported (export dialog completes)

steps.action: Choose Export on the bookmark, name the file and confirm.
steps.expected: The export progress bar appears and completes.

test_share_bookmark.title: Verify a bookmark can be shared (share dialog shows success)

steps.action: Choose Share on the bookmark, enter an address and confirm.
steps.expected: The dialog reports the share succeeded.

test_rename_bookmark.title: Verify a bookmark can be renamed and the new name appears

steps.action: Choose Rename on the bookmark, type a new name and save.
steps.expected: The bookmark row shows the new name.

test_delete_bookmark.title: Verify a bookmark can be deleted with confirmation

steps.action: Choose Delete on the bookmark and confirm.
steps.expected: The bookmark is no longer listed.
